one_line: Maratha statesman of the Barabhai Council, guiding Peshwa-era diplomacy in late 18th-century Pune.

appearance.age_look: Appears in his late 40s to early 50s, slim to medium build, slightly bookish yet steady posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a neat trimmed black moustache, light brown Deccan complexion, sharp observant eyes with slight under-eye shadows, a fine straight nose, faint smile lines, and a default calm, calculating but composed expression.
appearance.hair: Hair mostly concealed under a deep maroon Puneri-style pagadi (turban) with a slightly pointed front peak and a small gold cloth band; only a hint of black hair at the temples is visible, brushed back neatly.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length cotton angarkha in soft off-white with a wrapped front tied on the right side, over a slightly visible pale-saffron inner tunic; the angarkha has narrow cuffs and a subtle woven stripe texture; below, he wears straight, slightly tapered white churidar-style pyjamas gathered neatly at the ankles; over his shoulders sits a light-weight, finely woven cotton shawl in muted pale green with a narrow gold border, draped from the left shoulder across the torso; at his waist is a broad dark-indigo cotton kamarband (sash) wrapped twice with one neat knot at his right side, a small fabric pouch tucked into it; on his feet, simple brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes; he wears minimal jewellery—a thin gold chain at the neck just visible at the collar and a single small gold ring on his right hand—signalling status but not ostentation.
appearance.signature: A rolled bundle of official papers tied with red cloth, held in his right hand, with one partially unrolled scroll showing a wax seal, and a slim metal reed pen tucked into his kamarband beside it.

ref_desc: Nana Fadnavis is a late-40s Maratha statesman with an oval light-brown face, neat black moustache, deep maroon Puneri pagadi, off-white angarkha and churidar, pale-green shawl, dark-indigo kamarband, brown mojari shoes, and a rolled bundle of sealed papers with pen as his signature prop.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Nana Fadnavis: a late-40s Maratha statesman with an oval light-brown face, sharp observant eyes, and a neat trimmed black moustache, wearing a deep maroon Puneri-style turban with a slight front peak and a narrow gold band, a long off-white knee-length cotton angarkha wrapped and tied to the right over a faintly visible pale-saffron inner tunic, straight white churidar trousers gathered at the ankles, and a light pale-green woven shawl with a narrow gold border draped from his left shoulder across his torso; give him a broad dark-indigo cotton kamarband around his waist with a small fabric pouch and a slim metal reed pen tucked into it, simple brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes, minimal jewellery including a thin gold chain at his neck and a single small gold ring on his right hand, and have him hold a rolled bundle of official papers tied with red cloth, one scroll slightly unrolled to show a wax seal; keep his posture modest but steady and composed, colours clean and flat, making this exact face, turban, garments, and paper bundle clearly visible from head to toe.
